name: English: Memorize 114 working translation
src: Mafātīḥ al-Jinān (al-Qummī), from Ibn Ṭāwūs's Miṣbāḥ al-Zāʾir. Text checked word by word against two independent digital editions; variants noted.

v.1: O Allah, Lord of the great light, Lord of the lofty Seat, and Lord of the surging sea,
v.2: Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel and the Psalms, Lord of the shade and the scorching heat,
v.3: Revealer of the great Qurʾān, and Lord of the angels brought near, the prophets and the messengers.
v.4: O Allah, I ask You by Your noble Face, by the light of Your radiant Face, and by Your eternal kingdom.
v.5: O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting! I ask You by Your Name by which the heavens and the earths shine,
v.6: and by Your Name by which the first and the last are set right.
v.7: O Living One before every living thing, O Living One after every living thing, O Living One when nothing was living,
v.8: O Giver of life to the dead and Bringer of death to the living, O Ever-Living, there is no god but You.
v.9: O Allah, convey to our master the Imam — the guide, the rightly guided, who rises by Your command,
v.10: Allah's blessings be upon him and upon his pure forefathers —
v.11: on behalf of all the believing men and women in the easts and the wests of the earth,
v.12: its plains and its mountains, its land and its sea, and on behalf of me and my parents,
v.13: blessings equal to the weight of Allah's Throne and the ink of His words, as many as His knowledge has counted and His Book has encompassed.
v.14: O Allah, I renew for him, on the morning of this day of mine and for all the days I live,
v.15: a covenant, a pact and a pledge of allegiance to him upon my neck, from which I will never turn and never waver.
v.16: O Allah, make me among his supporters and helpers, and those who defend him,
v.17: who hasten to him to fulfil his needs, who carry out his commands,
v.18: who protect him, who race to do what he wills, and who are martyred before him.
v.19: O Allah, if death — which You have made a binding decree upon Your servants — comes between me and him,
v.20: then bring me out of my grave, wrapped in my shroud, my sword drawn, my spear bared,
v.21: answering the call of the caller among the town-dwellers and the desert-dwellers.
v.22: O Allah, show me the rightly guided countenance and the praiseworthy brow, and brighten my eyes with a glance at him.
v.23: Hasten his relief, ease his coming forth, widen his way, and lead me along his path.
v.24: Carry out his command and strengthen his back; through him, O Allah, bring Your lands to life and revive Your servants,
v.25: for You have said, and Your word is the truth: “Corruption has appeared on land and sea because of what people's hands have earned.”
v.26: So make manifest for us, O Allah, Your guardian, the son of Your Prophet's daughter, who bears the name of Your Messenger,
v.27: so that he finds no falsehood without tearing it apart, and establishes the truth and makes it real.
v.28: Make him, O Allah, a refuge for the oppressed among Your servants, and a helper for one who finds no helper but You,
v.29: a renewer of the rulings of Your Book that have been neglected,
v.30: and one who raises high the landmarks of Your religion and the ways of Your Prophet that have come down — Allah bless him and his family.
v.31: And make him, O Allah, among those You have fortified against the violence of aggressors.
v.32: O Allah, gladden Your Prophet Muhammad — Allah bless him and his family — by the sight of him and of those who follow him in his call,
v.33: and have mercy on our humbled state after him. O Allah, lift this grief from this community through his presence,
v.34: and hasten his appearance for us. They see it as far off, and we see it as near — by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
v.35: Hasten, hasten, O my master, O Master of the Age!
